tiny.notes: Fastest, lowest accuracy. Good for quick drafts.

small.notes: Default: good balance of speed and accuracy.

medium.notes: More accurate, especially for technical terms. Needs a GPU for comfortable speed.

large-v3.notes: Most accurate. Slow on CPU; in fp16 needs about 4.5 GB of VRAM.

large-v3-turbo.notes: Near large-v3 accuracy, much faster. Great on 8 GB GPUs.
